summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement (424B5) for a $ senior fixed-rate 5-year callable note offering due October 20, 2031, carrying a 6.50% coupon from original issue to maturity. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, issued at $1,000 per note (100%), with interest paid annually, 30/360 ISDA, and optional redemption on each October 20 from 2027 through 2030. Jefferies LLC, an affiliate, acts as agent, triggering FINRA Rule 5121 conflict-of-interest provisions; proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
